page_title: VAL 0-2 VIL | Valencia v Villarreal 25/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Dani Raba (Valencia) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
90+3' Diego Lopez (Valencia) darts into the box and immediately fires a first-time effort. He produces a poor shot which goes well over the crossbar.
90+3' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
90+1' Tajon Buchanan smashes in a cross, but Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) finds it almost impossible to control and sends his header high over the bar from close in.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Javier Alberola had an easy-decision to make.
89' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) offside.
88' Substitution. Alberto Moleiro walks off the pitch and Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) comes on as a substitute.
87' Diego Lopez (Valencia) attempts to find Arnaut Danjuma, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
87' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 7:5.
83' Carlos Corberan decides to make a substitution. Pepelu will be replaced by Baptiste Santamaria (Valencia).
83' Dani Raba (Valencia) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Thierry Correia.
83' This is a yellow card! Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
82' Thierry Correia (Valencia) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
80' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) finds his teammate inside the box with a sweet pass. However, Nicolas Pepe wasn't able to finish and lost the ball.
79' Here is a change. Georges Mikautadze is going off and Marcelino gives the last tactical orders to Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal).
79' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Santi Comesana walks off the pitch to be replaced by Dani Parejo (Villarreal).
77' Pepelu (Valencia) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Luiz Junior has no trouble gathering it.
77' Pepelu (Valencia) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
75' The total number of attempts is 12:9. The shots on goal statistics – 3:4.

70' Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) unleashes a promising shot towards the bottom left corner after his wonderful solo run, but Luiz Junior thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same.
69' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
69' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) whips in a cross from the corner, but Julen Agirrezabala is well positioned and punches the ball away.
68' Marcelino has decided to make a change. Thomas Partey (Villarreal) replaces Pape Gueye.
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) replaces Gerard Moreno.
67' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
67' Pepelu (Valencia) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
65' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) unleashed a long-range shot, but it misses narrowly over the bar. It could have been the goal of the month, at least.
64' Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Luiz Junior stops the ball from hitting the bottom left corner.
63' The resulting corner from Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) is cleared.
62' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Villarreal force a corner. They send men into the box.
61' Carlos Corberan has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Andre Almeida (Valencia) replacing Javi Guerra.
61' Today's match ends for Jose Gaya who will be replaced by Jesus Vazquez (Valencia).

57' 0 - 2 Georges Mikautadze fires in a promising shot which ricochets off the goalkeeper back to Santi Comesana (Villarreal) inside the box and he sends the ball into the back of the net. The score is 0:2.
55' Nicolas Pepe sprays a pass out to Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal), but he produces a poor effort from inside the box which goes high over the bar.
54' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) drills in an effort from the edge of the box that climbs rapidly and goes high over the bar.
54' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
52' Luis Rioja (Valencia) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

52' Good clearance! Luis Rioja (Valencia) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him. Valencia force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
51' The attendance for today's match is 45560.
50' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
49' Jose Gaya (Valencia) is penalised for a foul. Javier Alberola had a clear view and blows his whistle.
47' Pepelu (Valencia) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
47' The corner from Pepelu (Valencia) is hurriedly cleared.
47' Luis Rioja (Valencia) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Valencia.
46' Carlos Corberan makes a half-time substitution. Hugo Duro (Valencia) comes on in place of Lucas Beltran.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' Javier Alberola blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Pepelu (Valencia) will take the corner.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' 0 - 1 Goal! Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Julen Agirrezabala to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom right corner.
45' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
43' The referee is firm and issues Jose Copete (Valencia) a deserved yellow card.
43' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Villarreal!
43' Referee Javier Alberola makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Villarreal. Let’s see what happens!
41' PENALTY APPEAL after Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
40' Thierry Correia picks out Javi Guerra (Valencia), who drives a shot just wide of the right post from the edge of the box.

37' Jose Copete (Valencia) unleashed a powerful long-range strike, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way. Luis Rioja (Valencia) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
37' Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) sends a precise pass into the box, but Lucas Beltran loses the one-on-one with the defender.
36' Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
35' Lucas Beltran (Valencia) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
32' Total attempts – 4:1. 0:0 – this is the current number of shots on target.
31' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
29' Pepelu (Valencia) fires the ball from the free kick just outside the box, but he misdirects his shot high over the bar.
28' Javier Alberola blows his whistle. Santiago Mourino (Villarreal) commits a foul after dangerous play. Valencia are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
26' Villarreal are ruled offside.
25' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) took the corner.

25' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) latches on to a lofted pass from the resulting set piece and pulls the trigger from around the penalty spot. His effort towards the bottom right corner is saved by the excellent Julen Agirrezabala. The ball is out of play. Villarreal win a corner kick.
24' Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. Villarreal have a free kick.
23' Jose Gaya (Valencia) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Javier Alberola has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
21' Jose Gaya (Valencia) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
19' Javi Guerra (Valencia) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
18' Santiago Mourino (Villarreal) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
17' 46:54 – the latest ball possession ratio.
16' The defensive wall stood firm and easily blocked the powerfully hit free kick from Pepelu (Valencia) on the edge of the box.
15' Santiago Mourino (Villarreal) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
15' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.

15' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Javier Alberola blows his whistle for an infringement. Valencia have a free kick from a promising distance.
14' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

13' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. It will be a corner kick for Villarreal.
11' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Javier Alberola blows his whistle for a foul.
11' Great teamplay by Villarreal as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
9' The corner from Pepelu (Valencia) is intercepted by Luiz Junior.
8' Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
7' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) sprays a pass out to Georges Mikautadze, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
6' Jose Copete (Valencia) sends a long ball forward to Arnaut Danjuma, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
5' A pass from Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) is intercepted by Julen Agirrezabala and the move breaks down.
3' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Villarreal will kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Javier Alberola was nominated as the referee for this game.
